elements.evidence: The rendered clause retains a mutual restriction binding Customer: "Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services..." The redline narrows rather than deletes the covenant, so the preferred position (no restriction on Customer) is not achieved.
Rendered language opens "Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party", preserving the original mutuality of p0302 ("Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party").

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Scope narrowed from "the employees of the other party" to "personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services".

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: "for twelve months after their involvement ends" replaces "during the Term of this Agreement". The deterministic duration check reported "number not found" only because the period is spelled in words; on substance the temporal anchor (end of involvement) and the 12-month cap are both expressly stated.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: "; general advertisements and unsolicited approaches are excluded." — express carve-out added; corroborated by the carve-out regex (ok:true).

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Same added sentence expressly excludes "unsolicited approaches".

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative verb is limited to "solicit"; no "employ or engage", "hire", or no-hire language appears in the rendered clause, and none existed in p0302 requiring deletion.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: mutuality retained, scope narrowed to personnel directly involved in the Services, duration capped at twelve months from the end of involvement, and both general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs added, with no no-hire component.
Preferred level is not met because the covenant binding Customer survives; the finding correctly targets the fallback.

Minimality holds: the edits touch only scope, duration and carve-outs. Deletion of "during the Term of this Agreement" is required by the duration element, and dropping "for any reason" is necessary to avoid a retained absolute phrase contradicting the new general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs; no survival tails, procedures, damages or other extras were added.

Intent preserved: the clause remains a single mutual solicitation-only covenant in Section 22.14, leaves no undefined term or dangling cross-reference ("Services" and "party" are pre-existing usages), and no other commercial mechanic is disturbed.

Deviation classification is sound: the original barred solicitation of all employees for the entire multi-year Term with no carve-outs, failing the fallback on scope, duration and carve-outs (and approaching walk-away on all-personnel coverage).
Drafting note only (not a defect): consider using "12 months" in numerals so numeric duration checks resolve cleanly, but the spelled-out period is operatively sufficient.
